text.zh-CN:
牙脓肿是牙齿或牙龈感染后积聚脓液，通常需要牙医尽快处理。

- 常有持续牙痛、咬东西疼、冷热敏感或脸颊肿胀。
- 脓液流出后可能暂时不痛，但感染并未因此治好。
- 处理目标是清除感染，尽可能保住牙齿。
text.en:
A dental abscess is pus collecting around an infected tooth or gum and usually needs urgent dental care.

- Persistent toothache, pain on biting, temperature sensitivity or cheek swelling are typical.
- Drainage may temporarily reduce pain without curing infection.
- Treatment removes the infection and aims to preserve the tooth.

text.zh-CN:
细菌进入牙齿内部或牙龈组织后，可形成脓肿。

- 蛀牙破坏保护层，让细菌进入含神经和血管的牙髓。
- 裂牙、外伤和牙周病也可能提供感染入口。
- 未完全长出的牙齿及部分抗肿瘤治疗会增加风险。
text.en:
Bacteria entering a tooth or gum tissue can form an abscess.

- Decay damages the protective surface and allows infection into the pulp containing nerves and vessels.
- Cracked teeth, injury and gum disease offer other routes.
- Partly erupted teeth and some cancer treatments increase risk.

text.zh-CN:
面部感染影响呼吸、眼睛或深部组织时需急救。

- 难以呼吸、吞咽或说话，立即呼叫当地急救。
- 眼周肿痛或突然视力异常，立即急诊评估。
- 口腔大量肿胀或张口明显困难，不要继续在家等待牙痛自行缓解。
text.en:
Spread toward the airway, eyes or deep tissues needs emergency help.

- Call emergency services for difficulty breathing, swallowing or speaking.
- Eye swelling or pain with sudden visual problems needs immediate assessment.
- Marked mouth swelling or inability to open the mouth should not be watched at home.

text.zh-CN:
怀疑脓肿应预约急诊牙科。

- 持续搏动性牙痛、牙龈脓包或脸肿，即使没有发热也应尽快联系牙医。
- 一般门诊止痛不能代替引流、根管治疗或拔牙。
- 等待就诊期间出现肿胀扩展或全身明显不适，要升级为紧急医疗评估。
text.en:
Suspected abscess needs an urgent dental appointment.

- Persistent throbbing pain, a gum boil or facial swelling warrants prompt contact even without fever.
- Pain relief alone cannot replace drainage, root-canal treatment or extraction.
- Worsening swelling or feeling systemically unwell while waiting requires urgent reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
牙医通过口腔检查定位感染来源。

- 检查牙龈肿胀、脓液，以及轻敲或咬合时哪颗牙疼。
- 牙片可帮助了解牙根和周围骨组织，制定保牙或拔牙方案。
- 疼痛消失或肉眼看不到脓包，不能排除深部感染。
text.en:
A dental examination locates the infection.

- The dentist checks swelling, drainage and which tooth hurts on tapping or biting.
- X-rays help assess roots and surrounding bone and guide treatment.
- No visible gum boil, or fading pain, does not exclude deeper infection.

text.zh-CN:
牙痛的原因并不只有脓肿。

- 蛀牙或牙髓炎也可冷热敏感，但是否已形成积脓需要牙医判断。
- 牙周感染和未完全萌出的智齿，可造成相似牙龈肿痛。
- 脸肿迅速加重时，需要评估感染扩散，不能只按普通牙痛处理。
text.en:
Not every toothache is an abscess.

- Decay or inflamed pulp can also cause temperature sensitivity; an examination determines whether pus has collected.
- Gum infection or a partly erupted wisdom tooth may cause similar swelling.
- Rapidly increasing facial swelling requires assessment for spreading infection.

text.zh-CN:
治疗通过引流、根管治疗或拔牙处理感染源。

- 引流把积聚的脓液排出，减轻压力。
- 根管治疗清理牙齿内部感染组织，争取保留牙齿。
- 无法保留的牙齿可能需要拔除；严重扩散时可能住院。
text.en:
Treatment addresses the infection source through drainage, root-canal treatment or extraction.

- Drainage removes pus and reduces pressure.
- Root-canal treatment cleans infected tissue inside the tooth to try to preserve it.
- An unsalvageable tooth may need extraction; severe spread can require hospital care.

text.zh-CN:
药物是牙科处理的辅助。

- 对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬可暂时缓解疼痛，使用前核对禁忌和说明书。
- 抗生素由牙医按感染情况决定，不能代替必要的引流。
- 不要把阿司匹林贴在牙龈上，可能灼伤组织；勿因疼痛自行超量服药。
- 布洛芬可刺激胃，少数造成胃出血或肾脏问题；有胃溃疡、肾病、服抗凝药或怀孕者，止痛前先核对适用性。
text.en:
Medicines support dental treatment.

- Paracetamol or ibuprofen can temporarily relieve pain; check suitability and product instructions.
- The dentist decides whether antibiotics are needed; they do not replace necessary drainage.
- Do not place aspirin on gums, which can injure tissue, or exceed painkiller limits.
- Ibuprofen can irritate the stomach and occasionally cause gastrointestinal bleeding or kidney problems. Check suitability first with an ulcer history, kidney disease, anticoagulant use or pregnancy.

text.zh-CN:
饮食调整只帮助进食，不能清除脓肿。

- 暂选温凉的软食，如蛋羹、酸奶或土豆泥，减少咀嚼刺激。
- 避免过热、过冷及咬起来疼的硬食物。
- 能正常吞咽时补充水分；吞咽困难应立即求助，勿强行进食。
text.en:
Food changes help eating but cannot cure an abscess.

- Choose lukewarm soft foods such as eggs, yoghurt or mashed potato.
- Avoid very hot, cold or painful hard foods.
- Drink if swallowing normally; difficulty swallowing needs immediate help, not forced intake.

text.zh-CN:
等待和治疗后均需温和清洁。

- 用软毛牙刷清洁牙齿，不用尖物挑破脓包。
- 记录肿胀是否扩大、能否张口及是否发热，便于描述病情。
- 按牙医安排完成后续治疗，止痛后也不要取消预约。
text.en:
Gentle hygiene matters before and after treatment.

- Use a soft toothbrush and do not pierce a gum swelling.
- Note spreading swelling, mouth opening and fever to describe changes.
- Complete follow-up treatment even if the pain settles.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和其他治疗会影响处理选择。

- 儿童不能照搬成人止痛药方案，16岁以下不使用阿司匹林止痛。
- 接受化疗或放疗者应告诉牙医，感染和组织恢复需要额外关注。
- 怀孕或长期用药者应提供完整药物清单，以便选择适合的止痛及牙科治疗。
text.en:
Age and other treatment affect care choices.

- Children need age-appropriate pain relief; aspirin should not be used under age 16.
- Tell the dentist about chemotherapy or radiotherapy because infection and recovery need additional attention.
- Pregnancy and long-term medicines should be disclosed when choosing dental and pain treatment.

text.zh-CN:
及时处理后多数感染可以治好。

- 能否保住牙齿取决于受损程度和感染范围。
- 根管或拔牙后的复查用于确认愈合和后续修复需求。
- 疼痛、肿胀或发热重新出现，应联系牙医，不重复自行吃剩余抗生素。
text.en:
Most infections resolve with prompt treatment.

- Tooth preservation depends on damage and infection extent.
- Reviews after root-canal treatment or extraction assess healing and restoration needs.
- Recurrent pain, swelling or fever needs dental review, not leftover antibiotics.

text.zh-CN:
拖延治疗可能使感染扩大。

- 局部可破坏牙周组织和颌骨，导致牙齿松动或丢失。
- 感染扩散到面部或颈部会造成肿胀及吞咽困难。
- 进入血液或其他器官较少见但严重，出现急救信号需立即处理。
text.en:
Delaying treatment can allow infection to spread.

- Local damage may affect supporting tissues or jaw bone and cause tooth loss.
- Spread into face or neck tissues can impair swallowing.
- Bloodstream or distant-organ infection is less common but serious; act immediately on emergency signs.

text.zh-CN:
预防重点是减少蛀牙和及时修补损伤。

- 每天用含氟牙膏刷牙两次，并清洁牙缝。
- 按牙医建议检查，蛀牙、裂牙或外伤及时处理。
- 戒烟有利口腔健康。
text.en:
Prevention focuses on decay and prompt repair of damage.

- Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste and clean between teeth.
- Attend dental checks and address decay, cracks or injury promptly.
- Avoiding tobacco supports oral health.
